topic: feasibility study: msprof op simulator on a minimal equivalent model of v23

environment.soc_models: simulator/dav_3510 plus per-SoC models; Ascend950PR_9571..9599 and others are populated (159 MB each) but the exact Ascend950PR_9579 directory for this chip is empty
environment.smoke: msprof op simulator accepted --soc-version=Ascend950PR_9579 and ran a TileLang kernel end to end

outputs: simulator/coreN.veccoreM/coreN.veccoreM_instr_exe.csv with instr, pipe, call_count, cycles, running_time per instruction
dump/ with instr, dcache, ccu and exception logs
621 dependency relations extracted from the kernel
what_works.instr_level_value: this is strictly richer than device-side msprof, which only reports pipe busy percentages

minimal_model_tested.definition: 1 core, rows=4, d=4096, 6 iterations (24 rows): same tile shape and same code as v23, only the core count and iteration count reduced
minimal_model_tested.calibration: the simulator is within about 39% of the device on wall duration for the same model, same order of magnitude

critical_finding.instruction_mix: the simulated kernel reports SIMT_LDK / SIMT_STG / SIMT_IMUL / SIMT_FFMA instructions on pipes RVECLD (51% of cycles), RVECEX (27%), RVECST (17.6%), SCALAR (2.6%), MTE2 (0.1%)
critical_finding.device_for_same_model: vec 87.7% busy, mte2 27.3%, mte3 24.8% of a 5.83 us window
critical_finding.disagreement: the simulator accounts essentially no DMA (MTE2 0.1%) while the device reports DMA active 27% of the time on this model and 86-93% on the full kernel
critical_finding.bottleneck_flip: the 1-core model is vector-bound (vec 87.7%), but the real 64-core kernel is memory-bound (mte2 86-93%, vec 43-46%). Reducing the core count removes exactly the DRAM contention that is the real bottleneck.

decision.verdict: introduce, but narrowly scoped and never as the arbiter
keep: 64 cores, so the DRAM contention regime is preserved
reduce the ITERATION count instead (2-3 iterations = 128-192 tiles vs 2048), which cuts simulation time 16-32x while keeping the bandwidth contention
decision.do_not_use_for: DMA or bandwidth conclusions, because the simulator under-models MTE2 by two orders of magnitude
use_for: instruction mix and per-instruction cycle cost in the compute path
dependency and synchronization waits between the SimdVF block and the copies
generating hypotheses that the paired gate then decides on
decision.prerequisite: calibrate on a 64-core 2-iteration model: if its per-tile duration agrees with the real kernel within about 20%, the model is usable for compute-side attribution; otherwise restrict it to pure instruction-mix questions

next: build the 64-core / 2-iteration model next round and run the calibration
